result.question: Why did Uzziah build towers in the desert and dig many cisterns?

readings.answer: Because he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain.
readings.support: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain

assessments.reason: Verse 26:10 explicitly says, “Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns,” matching the answer.

result.reason: The passage directly states the reason: having much livestock led him to build towers and dig cisterns.
